appName: In to The Wild Hunt : The Last Hunter
displayName: In to The Wild Hunt : The Last Hunter
display_name: In to The Wild Hunt : The Last Hunter
display_long_description:
Step into the heart of nature and experience a realistic VR hunting adventure. This game is not only about aiming — it focuses on observing your surroundings, positioning yourself correctly, and acting at the right moment.

Explore vast natural environments, experience different locations, and improve your hunting skills. With realistic weapon handling, physics-based interactions, and immersive sound design, the game delivers a strong and believable hunting atmosphere in VR.

Designed to reward focus, patience, and skill, this experience appeals to both hunting simulation fans and players looking for a calm yet immersive VR adventure.
Every encounter is different, and every decision matters.

Key Features:

Immersive and realistic VR hunting experience

Exploration and environmental awareness-focused gameplay

Realistic weapon and control mechanics

Natural environments with atmospheric sound design

Tactical and patience-based gameplay

If you are looking for a respectful, balanced, and authentic VR hunting experience, this journey is for you.

Doğanın kalbine adım at ve gerçekçi bir VR avcılık deneyimi yaşa. Bu oyun, oyuncuya yalnızca hedef almayı değil; çevreyi gözlemlemeyi, doğru pozisyonu almayı ve doğru zamanda harekete geçmeyi öğretir.

Geniş ve doğal haritalarda keşfe çık, farklı ortamları deneyimle ve avlanma becerilerini geliştir. Gerçekçi silah mekanikleri, fizik tabanlı etkileşimler ve sürükleyici ses tasarımı sayesinde VR içinde güçlü bir av atmosferi sunulur.
